subject: LAB-043
check: Separate simulator smoke completion and release profile compatibility after the stopped full gate
steps: Through labr, sequentially create iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators with prefix NL LAB-043-B remaining; boot each and wait for simctl bootstatus -b.

For each: xcodebuild -project AppleNativeLab.xcodeproj -scheme "$LAB_043_SCHEME" -destination "id=$LAB_043_SIM" -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData -resultBundlePath "build/lab-043-$LAB_043_PLATFORM-smoke.xcresult" -collect-test-diagnostics never LAB_SOURCE_REVISION=ac808c9-dirty test -quiet; schemes LabPhone-Core, LabWatch, LabTV.
Delete each created simulator before creating the next; EXIT trap cleans only the current owned simulator.
Through the same labr invocation: python3 script/build_manifest.py.
Read the three xcresult summaries and the manifest log; no build or simulator was started outside labr.

outcome.detail: Separate explicitly booted simulator checks: iPhone 18 Pro / iOS 27.0 (24A434), 13/13; Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm) / watchOS 27.0 (24R362), 115/115; Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) / tvOS 27.0 (24J360), 181/181. No failures or skips. Release Source-lane manifest: CoreLocal, SystemSurfaces, Companions built and passed policy; CloudOptional and FrontierOptional skipped because no scheme is attached. Invocation exited 0. The known render flake did not appear.

limitations: Aggregate compatibility evidence uses the fixture path; the individual experiment fallback is separately recorded as iPhone simulator evidence.
Watch/TV smoke results prove host compatibility, not Respectful Attention live behavior or a dedicated experiment surface.
The original script/test.sh invocation failed at two pre-test iOS launch errors; these are separate checks and do not convert that invocation into a pass.
Simulator binaries and a local Mac build are not physical-device, signing-team, distribution, delivery, or release-ready proof.
